content: iMCP issue #148 (fetched via gh api, primary source): contacts_update fails with NSCocoaErrorDomain 134092 on every existing contact once its notes field is faulted in by CoreData, because the com.apple.developer.contacts.notes entitlement is missing. Apple requires a separate approval form for this entitlement (~1 week turnaround, may be rejected) even to READ a nil notes field on an existing card. contacts_create works because new contacts have no notes to fault.
